The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Says the key only helps if the backend documents that it honours it and asks the backend owner to confirm
- Notes that backends may rely on database constraints instead and that a missing key is a backend change
- Queues only writes the server makes safe to replay, with ordering, status and per-user partitioning

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
